headline: Names a Lebanon, Pennsylvania post office building after Lieutenant William D. Lebo.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 101 South 8th Street in Lebanon, Pennsylvania, as the Lieutenant William D. Lebo Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on May 7, 2024, and the name took effect on that date.
